📌 Ethena takes USDe basis trade into tokenized US equities 

🔖 Ethena has added tokenized U.S. equities and equity perpetual futures to the basis trading strategy used for part of USDe’s backing, taking a funding model previously centered on crypto markets into listed stocks. According to a statement shared with cryptomedia, Ethena will use Binance’s bStocks as the spot side of the trade while taking offsetting positions through equity perpetual futures on the exchange. 

⭐️ The structure follows a framework previously approved by the Ethena Risk Committee for adding tokenized equity basis trades to the protocol’s allocation strategy. Ethena has historically used a delta neutral approach in crypto markets, pairing asset exposure with derivatives positions intended to hedge movements in the underlying asset. 

📊 Under the new setup, bStocks will provide tokenized equity exposure while Binance’s corresponding perpetual contracts will provide the hedge. The strategy seeks to capture the difference between the spot and perpetual markets without relying primarily on the direction of the underlying stock.

Just like Mino, Clicko was designed around a simple, thick rectangular body.

We wanted a shape that felt solid, friendly, recognizable, and trustworthy, without making the character unnecessarily complicated.

But while Mino’s structure communicates precision and stability, Clicko’s design is much more energetic.

⚡ THE HYPERACTIVE ONE

Clicko is the complete opposite of Mino.

He’s fast, enthusiastic, curious, and always ready to click.

His cheerful expression reflects the experience we wanted to associate with Handybot Clickers ™: active, engaging, and rewarding.

That’s also why you’ll rarely see Clicko standing still.

🖱️ THE TWO BUTTONS

Look at Clicko’s chest.

You’ll find two buttons, representing the two sides of the Clickers ecosystem:

📢 Publish Ads — for advertisers who want to promote their services.

👀 View Ads — for Clickers who want to discover advertisements and complete tasks.

His body literally represents the interaction between advertisers and Clickers.

🚀 THE JETPACK

Behind Clicko’s shoulders is his integrated jetpack.

Why?

Because Clicko is all about speed and movement. He’s constantly jumping from one task to another, discovering new advertisements and keeping the ecosystem active.

💚 CLICKO IS MORE THAN A MASCOT

His thick body, massive feet, flexible black arms, expressive face, chest buttons and jetpack were all designed to tell the same story:

Clicko is the active side of Handybot.

He moves. He clicks. He explores.

🤖 That’s Clicko — the little robot that never stops clicking.

Azerbaijan is preparing visas and residence permits for digital nomads

On September 24, the Parliamentary Committee on Economic Policy reviewed amendments to the Migration Code. If the law passes, starting from January 1, 2027, foreigners working remotely will be able to obtain a business visa, temporary residence permit, and even permanent residency. This is not for every freelancer with a laptop. The list is narrow: IT, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, innovations.

The income threshold is tied to the local minimum wage. Currently, it is 400 manats, around 235 dollars. To apply for a visa or temporary residence permit, one must demonstrate an average overseas income for the last six months not less than 13 times the minimum wage - 5,200 manats, approximately 3,060 dollars per month. For permanent residency, the threshold is doubled: 26 times the minimum wage, around 6,120 dollars.

The temporary residence permit is granted for up to three years with the possibility of extension. An invitation from the receiving party is not required. There is also no examination on the Azerbaijani language and basic legislation, which is the main privilege. Then, conditions begin that are not present in the usual "nomad visa for a year and then leave."

To obtain a residence permit or permanent residency, one will have to register for tax purposes and work as a resident of the technopark. Additionally, the individual becomes part of the state social insurance. This scheme is closer to that of a specialist whom the country wants to retain in its digital zone, rather than a tourist with Wi-Fi.

In comparison with the market, Thailand on DTV requires savings of around 500,000 baht and does not require a local tax on foreign income if you do not become a tax resident. Malaysia holds the threshold for tech professionals from 24,000 dollars per year. Azerbaijan sets a monthly income higher than many Asian programs but offers a three-year residence permit upfront and a path to permanent residency — if you are willing to enter the technopark.

The law has not been passed yet. This is a committee draft. It is not possible to submit an application now. It makes sense to follow the text until January: the wording "resident of the technopark" will determine whether this is a real entry point for remote workers or only a filter for those already treated as investors by Baku.
